payload.title: Synthetic Access Control
payload.statement: Ensure all access to production environments is authorized and logged

payload.title: Quarterly User Access Review Records
payload.guidance: Provide quarterly user access review exports signed off by department heads.

payload.title: Quarterly User Access Review Audit Procedure
payload.objective: Verify that user access reviews are conducted quarterly and documented.
payload.sample_guidance: Sample 25% of active users across all production systems.
payload.decision_guidance: Pass if all sample reviews were signed off within 14 days of quarter end.
payload.assessor_qualifications: Certified Internal Auditor or equivalent experience.

steps.instruction: Request the quarterly user access review schedule and reviewer assignments.
steps.expected_output: Approved access review schedule and assigned reviewers list.

steps.instruction: Inspect ticket sign-off timestamps against sample selection.
steps.expected_output: Signed approval tickets for all selected sample accounts.
